title: Dispose temporary SDF evaluator buffers on exceptional paths
description:
Council 100+ round resource-lifecycle review confirmed SdfProgramEvaluator.Evaluate(NativeArray<SdfOperation>.ReadOnly, ...) allocates a temporary NativeArray<float> and disposes it only after EvaluateInto returns. If EvaluateInto throws on malformed operation data, the temporary allocation is not disposed by the method.

Scope: wrap the temporary allocation/use in try/finally without changing evaluation semantics. Add a regression that exercises the exceptional path where practical, then verify normal reference/culled evaluation parity.

Do not add a broader allocation abstraction; this is a local ownership bug.

Validation gate: runtime build, focused evaluator tests, and Unity execution before closure.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Implementation verified on the current branch: SdfProgramEvaluator.Evaluate(NativeArray<SdfOperation>.ReadOnly, ...) wraps its temporary values allocation and EvaluateInto call in try/finally, guaranteeing disposal on both normal and exceptional paths. A focused regression was added for the exceptional path via an invalid RootIndex; the guard throws inside the try and the temporary allocation is deterministically disposed.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: Validation evidence: commit a4fe7cd9a5f2e05ae53f4685d5fc28dd317189fa recorded focused 1/1 for the exception/disposal regression, SDF fixtures 24/24, full PlayMode 380/385 with the five documented pre-existing failures, console clean, and 0 compile errors. The disposal change itself is also present in current SdfProgramEvaluator source. No new Unity execution was performed in this audit response; the cited Unity run is historical repository evidence on this code line.
